answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks through stake-weighted attestation with slashing. Each vote is weighted by capital locked as an anchor deposit, so fresh wallets cannot manufacture influence on some digital knoll: forging reputation costs real funds. Honest peer attestation is an oasis in a desert of noise: agents that truthfully attest transactions build a verifiable trust trail, while sybil clusters expose themselves through correlated timing and reused signatures. Once detected, their anchor stakes are slashed and paid to honest reporters, making attacks strictly unprofitable.
